aggregate_source_equivalence.comparison_performed: Trade archive total base and quote volumes were compared with official 4h candles on 2024-10-06 for both assets and markets. This validates base/quote units, not an alternative imbalance measure.
aggregate_source_equivalence.reason: Official kline response supplies OHLC, total volume and turnover but no taker buy/sell split; it cannot reproduce the frozen signed-flow feature. Therefore transaction-level archives remain necessary.

status_rule: PASS denotes same economic concept and compatible transformation/aggregation; venue-specific scale/population differences are documented. Coverage is separately evaluated in panel_audit.json.

Basis.aggregation_rule: Join exact five-minute timestamps; require 48 matched observations; average mark/index-1.
Basis.binance_original_definition: Mean((mark close / index close)-1) over 48 matched five-minute observations in each 4h interval.
Basis.bybit_timestamp_semantics: Five-minute startTime in UTC milliseconds; each record is a candle interval, closePrice is the interval close/latest trade if still open.
Basis.justification: Same formula, units and interval aggregation. Official docs: https://bybit-exchange.github.io/docs/v5/market/mark-kline and https://bybit-exchange.github.io/docs/v5/market/index-kline
known_differences: Mark/index construction is venue-specific, but both are provider-defined components and formula matches the frozen Binance feature.
Basis.transformation: basis_mean and frozen basis_change = current 4h basis minus previous 4h basis.

Funding.aggregation_rule: As-of interval end; maximum age 12 hours; no interpolation or synthetic settlement.
Funding.binance_original_definition: Settlement funding-rate observation; latest event at or before the 4h interval end, carried forward no more than 12 hours.
Funding.bybit_timestamp_semantics: Funding settlement timestamp (Unix ms); API documentation explains a rate stamped at settlement is the latest settled rate.
Funding.justification: Bybit returns a settled rate with an explicit settlement timestamp and the same event-state/as-of rule can be applied. Official docs: https://bybit-exchange.github.io/docs/v5/market/history-fund-rate
known_differences: Funding interval can vary by symbol or regime; actual historical settlement gaps are audited and retained.
Funding.transformation: funding_rate_state; frozen funding_change = current state minus prior 4h state.
Funding.units: Decimal rate per funding settlement interval; not annualized.

Futures Taker Imbalance.aggregation_rule: Within each 4h bin, sum homeNotional base quantity separately for Buy/Sell aggressor sides; (buy-sell)/(buy+sell), denominator must be positive.
Futures Taker Imbalance.binance_original_definition: (taker buy base volume - taker sell base volume)/(taker buy base volume + taker sell base volume); Binance source reconstructs sell as total base volume minus taker-buy base volume.
Futures Taker Imbalance.bybit_timestamp_semantics: Trade execution/match timestamp; archive stores fractional Unix seconds for linear trades; assigned to 4h UTC bin by flooring to millisecond time.
Futures Taker Imbalance.justification: Same aggressor-side base-volume imbalance; flow remains transaction-level. Official docs: https://bybit-exchange.github.io/docs/v5/websocket/public/trade and https://bybit-exchange.github.io/docs/v5/market/kline
known_differences: Bybit raw archive field names differ. `side` is documented as side of taker in Bybit public trades. Bybit linear kline volume is base coin. Archive homeNotional summed to linear kline base volume with mean relative absolute error <= 4.6e-13 in a fixed in-window six-bar check for both BTC and ETH. The kline source lacks buyer/seller split, so it cannot replace trade-level flow.
Futures Taker Imbalance.transformation: futures_taker_imbalance; frozen flow_shock uses the 180 prior 4h values with median/MAD and scale 1.4826.
Futures Taker Imbalance.units: Base coin quantity in numerator and denominator; normalized imbalance is dimensionless, [-1,1].

OI Log Change.aggregation_rule: As-of interval end with age <=4h, then consecutive 4h log difference.
OI Log Change.binance_original_definition: First log difference of 4h open-interest level.
OI Log Change.justification: The identical within-series log-difference operation removes constant scale differences.
known_differences: Per-venue positions are not directly comparable in level; this variable compares within-venue growth only.

Open Interest.aggregation_rule: Use openInterest (not singleOpenInterest), last available snapshot at or before interval end, maximum age 4h.
Open Interest.binance_original_definition: 4h open-interest level reconstructed from Binance USDⓈ-M perpetual open-interest metrics; both-side aggregate.
Open Interest.bybit_timestamp_semantics: UTC millisecond snapshot timestamp; selected intervalTime=4h.
Open Interest.justification: The transformed economic concept is percentage change in outstanding linear-perpetual exposure, and Bybit’s unit difference cancels under log differences. Official docs: https://bybit-exchange.github.io/docs/v5/market/open-interest
known_differences: Raw unit and endpoint sampling convention differ; only log changes enter the feature set. Any contract multiplier/unit break would invalidate parity and is checked in the snapshot series.
Open Interest.transformation: OI Log Change = log(OI_t/OI_{t-1}); invariant to fixed unit scale.
Open Interest.units: Bybit linear BTCUSDT openInterest is BTC; ETHUSDT is ETH; provider documents openInterest as both-side sum. Binance reports exchange contract units; levels are not compared.

Spot Price.aggregation_rule: 4h UTC OHLC from 48 5m candles; close is the final 5m candle close.
Spot Price.binance_original_definition: Spot traded price from 5m candles; 4h open/high/low/close reconstructed on UTC boundaries; 4h close is last 5m close.
Spot Price.bybit_timestamp_semantics: 5m candle startTime in UTC milliseconds; closePrice is last traded price for a closed candle.
Spot Price.justification: Same traded-price candle concept and UTC aggregation. Official docs: https://bybit-exchange.github.io/docs/v5/market/kline
known_differences: Bybit spot represents one venue, not global spot market; same-venue spot/futures dependence remains an interpretation limitation.
Spot Price.transformation: 4h log return from consecutive 4h closes; input to target and spot-only state features.

Spot Quote Volume.aggregation_rule: Sum turnover across 48 five-minute spot candles; require complete 48-bar interval.
Spot Quote Volume.binance_original_definition: 4h sum of spot quote-asset volume, USDT-denominated.
bybit_fields: spot kline turnover (quote turnover in USDT); cross-check against trade-level price*base quantity.
Spot Quote Volume.justification: Bybit kline turnover is quote-currency turnover; archive trades independently reconcile to aggregated candle turnover to numerical precision in the fixed audit day. Official docs: https://bybit-exchange.github.io/docs/v5/market/kline
known_differences: Venue-specific trade population and fees/market operation; baseline remains Bybit spot only.
Spot Quote Volume.transformation: Used as Amihud denominator; quote_volume_growth = diff(log(positive 4h quote turnover)).
